speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Education)
text: Speaker, mental health issues occur in a variety of forms and severity levels.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Education)
text: Some students remain undiagnosed due to lack of awareness or prefer not to disclose their condition for various reasons.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Education)
text: Mental health issues are on the rise internationally.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Education)
text: The World Health Organization projected that mental illness rates will continue to increase.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Education)
text: Students are particularly vulnerable as they grapple with significant social, emotional and physical transitions in their growing up years.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Education)
text: Having said that, most do not develop mental health issues but need support, especially from their families, for personal issues.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Education)
text: Schools and post-secondary institutions also provide support to students regardless of whether they have a specific diagnosis.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Education)
text: Our teachers and lecturers are equipped to look out for students in distress, provide timely support, and refer them to school counsellors for additional support where necessary.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Education)
text: We are monitoring the levels of stress and taking systematic steps to take care of students’ well-being and strengthen their resilience.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Education)
text: We are also working closely with parents to raise awareness on mental health, so as to encourage early identification and increase help-seeking for their children.

speaker: Dr Intan Azura Mokhtar (Ang Mo Kio)
text: Speaker, I thank the Senior Parliamentary Secretary for the answers.

speaker: Mr Speaker
